items.title: Cisco Drops 7% on Gross Margin Fears: Five Firms Raise CSCO Price Target Anyway
items.summary: Cisco beat earnings, crushed revenue estimates, and racked up billions in AI orders, yet the stock cratered 7% anyway. Five analyst firms still raised their price targets, but the spread between the most bearish and most bullish tells a story of deep Wall Street disagreement about where Cisco goes from here.
